evals.prompt:
/shape-idea
웹 페이지 URL을 Markdown으로 변환해 LLM으로 바로 넘기는 서비스.

## 사용자 흐름
1. URL 붙여넣기, 지우기 버튼으로 리셋
2. 본문을 Markdown으로 추출 (Defuddle 필수, https://defuddle.md/docs 참조)
3. 페이지 제목·저자 헤더 + 렌더링된 Markdown 확인
4. 복사하기 / .md 다운로드 / ChatGPT·Claude로 열기

프롬프트는 요약, 한국어 번역, 쉽게 설명 프리셋과 1회용 직접 입력을 지원하고 다크 모드가 필요해.
evals.expected_output: The response begins a grill-style interview grounded in the supplied requirements and Defuddle documentation. It asks exactly one consequential upstream question, includes a recommended answer and rationale, and waits for the answer instead of implementing or prototyping the whole product.
expectations: The response asks exactly one question and waits for the user's answer.
The question addresses a material unresolved branch rather than a routine implementation detail.
The response provides a recommended answer with a concise reason.
It treats the supplied requirements and authoritative Defuddle documentation as facts to investigate rather than questions for the user.
It invokes the project-knowledge skill before asking its first question.
It does not begin production implementation or prototype the entire product.

evals.prompt: /shape-idea 기존 용어집에서는 유료 계정을 Member라고 부르지만, 팀은 이제 Subscriber로 통일하기로 확정했어. 이 결정은 용어집에 바로 반영하고, 이어서 기존 Member의 권한 이전 정책을 나와 정리해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response uses project-knowledge during the session: it records the already-resolved terminology change in the glossary immediately, notes the conflict with the prior term, then asks one upstream permissions question with a recommendation. It does not postpone the glossary update until a final summary.
expectations: The response treats Subscriber as a resolved canonical term and updates GLOSSARY.md before continuing.
It explicitly reconciles or challenges the conflicting prior Member terminology.
After the glossary update, it asks no more than one permissions question.
The question includes a recommended answer and rationale.
It records the glossary change itself instead of postponing it to the final summary or delegating it to another skill.

evals.prompt: /shape-idea 프롬프트 프리셋 세 개 중 정확히 하나를 고르게 하려 해. 세 옵션은 항상 보여야 하고 선택 즉시 적용돼. 우리 디자인 시스템 문서에는 Select는 공간이 부족할 때, Checkbox는 복수 선택, RadioGroup은 소수의 상호 배타적 옵션에 쓴다고 적혀 있어. 드롭다운, 그룹 버튼, 체크박스 중 뭘 쓸지 정해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response resolves the control from established interaction semantics without rendering anything for the user to judge. It recommends the existing single-choice group pattern, states the assumption that the choice is implied by the design system, and continues only if another material branch remains.
expectations: The response uses the supplied design-system semantics instead of asking the user to choose among controls.
It rejects checkbox because the options are mutually exclusive and avoids a dropdown because all three options should remain visible.
It recommends the established RadioGroup or equivalent existing group control.
It does not render variants for a question already answered by project evidence.
It states any relevant assumption it decided alone.

evals.prompt: /shape-idea 결과 화면의 핵심 작업은 Markdown 읽기와 LLM으로 보내기야. 기존 컴포넌트와 데이터는 정해졌는데, LLM 작업을 기본 화면에 펼칠지 버튼을 누른 뒤 열지 실제로 보기 전에는 판단이 안 돼. 이 한 가지를 비교해서 결정하고 인터뷰를 계속해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response classifies this as an experiential question and renders two or three variants (the LLM workflow persistent versus revealed on demand) in an available visual medium, keeping the confirmed components and data fixed. It asks for the user's reaction, records the chosen feature-local behavior for the spec without automatically promoting it to a project decision contract, and resumes the interview.
expectations: The comparison is limited to whether the LLM workflow is persistent or revealed on demand.
It renders two or three materially different variants in an available visual medium instead of describing them in prose.
It asks for a reaction rather than approval of a plan to build something.
It translates the reaction into a confirmed feature decision for the spec and does not automatically promote it to a project decision contract.
It does not broaden the render into redesigning the whole result page.

evals.prompt: /shape-idea 모든 결정을 마쳤어. 공개 HTML의 최초 응답만 Defuddle로 변환하고, 입력과 결과는 저장하지 않아. 복사와 md 다운로드를 지원하며, ChatGPT와 Claude는 프롬프트와 Markdown을 클립보드에 복사한 뒤 새 탭으로 연다. 동적 페이지와 로그인 페이지는 제외해. 이제 정리해줘.
evals.expected_output: Because all material branches are resolved, the response stops interviewing, summarizes confirmed decisions, rationale, assumptions, deferred or excluded scope, and remaining risks, and materializes that content as a spec folder at docs/specs/<slug>/spec.md. It does not force a named alignment-brief template or invent further questions.
expectations: The response asks no new question when no material branch remains.
It summarizes the confirmed decisions and their rationale.
It identifies assumptions, excluded or deferred scope, and remaining risks where applicable.
It writes the confirmed decisions to the spec folder as docs/specs/<slug>/spec.md for a later implementation session.
It does not require a fixed alignment-brief format or another confirmation ceremony.

evals.prompt: /shape-idea 변환 결과 화면의 컴포넌트와 대표 데이터는 확정됐어. 남은 건 결과 헤더야. 제목, 저자, 날짜, 원본 링크, 예상 읽기 시간까지 다 보여줄지, 제목과 저자만 남길지 아직 못 정했어. 계속 진행해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response classifies header density as an experiential question and renders without being asked to show anything: two or three variants differing only in header density, with confirmed components and data fixed, requesting the user's reaction as the answer.
expectations: It treats header density as a question judged by looking rather than one to argue in prose.
It renders the comparison although the user never asked to see alternatives.
The variants differ materially only in header density while confirmed components and data stay fixed.
It requests the user's reaction as the answer to this one question.
It does not ask the user to imagine or verbally compare the alternatives.

evals.prompt: /shape-idea 헤더 밀도는 변형 비교에서 제목·저자·읽기 시간 구성으로 확정했어. 나머지 결정도 모두 끝났어. 이제 마무리해줘.
evals.expected_output: Because every material branch is resolved, the response summarizes confirmed decisions, rationale, assumptions, deferred scope, and remaining risks, and writes the spec folder anchor docs/specs/<slug>/spec.md as the session's deliverable. The comparison renders stay disposable scaffolding rather than deliverables.
expectations: The response asks no new question.
It summarizes confirmed decisions, rationale, assumptions, and remaining risks.
It materializes the summary as the spec folder anchor docs/specs/<slug>/spec.md.
It treats the earlier comparison renders as disposable scaffolding, not as deliverables to hand over.

evals.prompt: /shape-idea 남은 결정은 하나야. 무료 플랜의 프로젝트 개수 제한을 3개로 할지 5개로 할지 아직 못 정했어. 과금 정책 문서는 아직 없고, 요금제 페이지 컴포넌트는 확정됐어. 계속 진행해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response treats the plan limit as a propositional trade-off and settles it in prose: exactly one question with a recommended answer and rationale, and no rendering of any visual medium for a question prose answers in one round.
expectations: The response asks exactly one question with a recommended answer and rationale.
It settles the question in prose without rendering any visual medium.
It does not produce a diagram, mockup, or variant comparison for this propositional choice.
It does not invent additional questions beyond the single remaining branch.

evals.prompt: /shape-idea 기존 SaaS 대시보드의 알림 설정을 추가하려고 해. 제공 채널, 기본값, 저장 방식은 확정됐고 남은 건 각 채널을 항상 펼쳐 보여줄지 요약 행에서 확장할지야. 현재 설정 화면은 레포에서 실행할 수 있고 관련 컴포넌트도 있어. 계속 진행해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response treats the remaining disclosure pattern as a material experiential decision. It first inspects the runnable current settings surface, renders alternatives in that product context, exercises their changed states, and then presents the alternatives together as one review and waits for the user's reaction. It does not treat successful state transitions as user approval.
expectations: It inspects the current runnable settings surface before settling the new disclosure pattern.
It limits the alternatives to always-expanded versus summary-row expansion while preserving confirmed channels, defaults, save behavior, and existing components.
It exercises the changed states itself before presenting them.
It presents the related alternatives together as one user review and waits for the user's reaction.
It keeps functional self-verification separate from the user's experiential judgment.

evals.prompt: /shape-idea 실행 가능한 프리뷰에 이미 승인한 알림 토글을 반영했어. 구성과 상호작용은 승인된 디자인 시스템 패턴 그대로고, 간격과 문구 같은 일상적인 시각 결정은 네게 위임할게. 다른 결정도 모두 끝났어. 마무리해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response inspects the preview and exercises the changed toggle state, but does not force another user review because the interaction is already confirmed and routine presentation details were explicitly delegated. It records why review was skipped, treats the explicit delegation as a confirmed instruction rather than an assumption, closes with the normal summary and spec folder, and does not preserve the component preview as prototype.html.
expectations: It inspects the runnable preview and verifies the changed toggle state.
It does not ask for another visual review of an already-confirmed interaction.
It treats routine spacing and copy decisions as explicitly delegated rather than silently assumed.
It records why review was skipped and does not misclassify the user's explicit delegation as an assumption.
It does not preserve the isolated component preview as prototype.html.
It closes with the normal decision summary and spec folder.

evals.prompt: /shape-idea 워크스페이스 초대 상태는 확정했어. 초대는 pending에서 시작해 7일 뒤 expired가 되고, 수락하면 membership을 만들면서 accepted가 돼. 관리자는 pending 초대를 revoked로 바꿀 수 있고, expired나 revoked 주소를 다시 초대하면 기존 초대를 되살리지 않고 새 초대를 만들어. 기존 멤버에게는 두 번째 membership을 만들면 안 돼. 남은 건 이 상태와 동작이 제대로 연결됐는지 확인하는 거야. 계속 진행해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response mirrors the multi-branch invitation state model in exactly one diagram before moving to a downstream decision. It may ask at most one question about an unresolved part of that diagram, then waits for the response.
expectations: It renders exactly one diagram of the invitation state model.
The diagram includes the pending-to-accepted, pending-to-expired, and pending-to-revoked transitions and distinguishes reinviting from reopening an old invitation.
It presents the diagram as a correctable draft of its current understanding.
It asks at most one question, and that question concerns an unresolved part of the diagram.
It waits for the user's response before moving to a downstream security or implementation decision.
It does not replace the diagram with only prose or a bullet list.

evals.prompt: /shape-idea 배치 동기화가 늦어 권한이 오래 남는 문제를 이벤트 기반 증분 동기화로 바꾸기로 했어. 남은 건 실패한 이벤트를 자동 재시도할지 운영자 큐로 보낼지야. 계속 진행해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response recognizes a concrete technical problem, intended change, and broad direction. It investigates available system evidence and resolves the remaining failure-policy branch through the normal one-question, recommended-answer discipline.
expectations: It does not require a product audience before shaping the concrete technical change.
It treats event failure policy as the remaining material branch.
It asks at most one question with a recommended answer and rationale after investigating available evidence.
It does not begin implementation.

evals.prompt: /shape-idea CSV 가져오기는 업로드, 형식 검사, 저장의 세 단계로 확정했어. 분기나 예외 흐름은 없어. 이 흐름에 대한 이해만 확인하고 계속해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response mirrors the confirmed linear flow in one concise prose sentence and does not render a diagram or invent branches. It may continue with at most one consequential prose question.
expectations: It states the upload-to-validation-to-save flow in one concise prose sentence.
It does not render a diagram, mockup, or variant comparison.
It does not invent branches, failure states, or exception handling.
It asks at most one consequential question in prose and waits for the response.

evals.prompt: /shape-idea 공개 HTML의 최초 응답만 Markdown으로 변환하고 입력과 결과는 저장하지 않아. 복사와 md 다운로드를 지원하고, 동적 페이지와 로그인 페이지는 범위에서 제외해. 이 결정들로 구현할 수 있어.
evals.expected_output: The response recognizes that every implementation-relevant decision is resolved without waiting for an explicit completion declaration. It asks no new question, summarizes the decisions and risks, writes docs/specs/<slug>/spec.md, and does not prompt for another action.
expectations: It does not ask the user to confirm that shaping is complete.
It asks no new product question when the supplied decisions are implementation-ready.
It summarizes confirmed decisions, assumptions, deferred points, and remaining risks where applicable.
It writes the same content to docs/specs/<slug>/spec.md.
It does not ask whether to begin implementation or prompt for another action.

evals.prompt: /shape-idea 로그인 흐름을 네이티브 앱에서 이메일 주소 입력 → 인증 코드 입력에서 로그인 방법 선택 → 이메일 주소 입력 → 인증 코드 입력으로 바꾸려고 해. 기존 코드 입력 화면의 디자인과 네이티브 숫자 키패드는 유지해. 주소 변경, 6자리 붙여넣기, 잘못된 코드 오류, 재요청 동작까지 새 로그인 흐름 전체를 프로토타입으로 만들어 검토하게 해주고, 바뀐 점도 알려줘.
evals.expected_output: The response treats the existing login surface as grounding evidence and builds only the proposed product surface for review. Every visible element inside the phone frame is plausible end-user UI: review notes and change explanations stay in the conversation. The screen selector names product destinations such as 로그인 방법, 이메일 주소 입력, and 인증 코드 입력 without current/proposed labels, step numbers, indexes, or progress wording.
expectations: It uses the existing login surface as design evidence without duplicating the baseline as current or before screens that the user did not ask to compare.
Every visible element inside the product screen is plausible end-user UI; review notes, change summaries, rationale, and instructions remain outside the prototype.
The screen selector identifies product destinations by role and does not use current, proposed, new, before, after, numbered-step, index, or progress labels.
The proposed flow contains the login-method, email-address, and verification-code product screens with the established code-screen design and relevant interactions.
Address change, six-digit paste, and other one-click changes remain product interactions rather than review-state presets.
The response keeps the review open for reactions to the proposed product surface.

evals.prompt: /shape-idea 감사 로그 내보내기를 정리해줘. 관리자는 기간과 이벤트 종류를 골라 CSV를 내려받을 수 있어야 하고, 자기 조직의 로그만 포함돼야 해. 최대 기간은 90일이고 내보내기 기록은 저장하지 않아. 다른 결정은 없고 바로 구현 가능한 spec으로 마무리해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response closes without another question and writes spec.md as the stable product contract: user-visible outcomes, scope, observable acceptance criteria, settled constraints, assumptions, off-limits areas, deferred points, and remaining risks. It records behavior rather than predicted files, functions, code structure, or implementation steps.
expectations: It asks no new question because every implementation-relevant product decision is supplied.
It states the user-visible export outcome and the approved scope, including organization isolation and the 90-day limit.
It writes observable acceptance criteria that can verify the completed behavior without prescribing implementation internals.
It records applicable settled constraints, assumptions, off-limits areas, deferred points, and remaining risks in spec.md.
It does not predict files, functions, code structure, technical layers, or a step-by-step implementation sequence.

evals.prompt: /shape-idea 사용자가 워크스페이스에서 스스로 탈퇴할 수 있게 해줘. 그런데 마지막 소유자가 탈퇴할 때 소유권과 데이터가 어떻게 되는지는 아직 정하지 않았어. 일단 나머지는 적당히 채워서 바로 구현 spec으로 끝내줘.
evals.expected_output: The response does not silently turn the consequential last-owner policy into settled behavior or acceptance criteria. It asks one concrete question with a recommendation, or explicitly defers the unresolved branch and records its impact as a remaining risk; only cheap reversible defaults may remain labeled assumptions.
expectations: It identifies last-owner ownership and data handling as a consequential unresolved product decision.
It does not invent a last-owner transfer, deletion, retention, or blocking policy as confirmed scope or acceptance criteria.
It asks at most one concrete question with a recommended answer and rationale, or explicitly defers that exact branch with its impact.
Any agent-chosen routine detail remains an overridable assumption rather than a settled product constraint.
It does not claim the product contract is implementation-ready while the consequential branch is neither settled nor explicitly deferred.

evals.prompt: /shape-idea 첨부한 저장소 루트 PRODUCT.md를 제품 맥락으로 사용해줘. 이번에는 승인 전에 고객이 범위 항목 하나에 질문을 남길 수 있게 하려 해. 동작을 정리해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response reads the attached app-level premise before shaping comment behavior, carries its prompt-hidden account-free client and clarity constraints into the work-unit discussion, and leaves PRODUCT.md unchanged rather than duplicating it.
expectations: It reads the attached PRODUCT.md rather than relying only on product details repeated in the prompt.
It preserves account-free client participation and unmistakable inclusion and exclusion as constraints when shaping the comment behavior.
It does not copy the complete product context into the work-unit spec.
It leaves the attached PRODUCT.md unchanged and does not create another app-level product artifact.

evals.prompt: /shape-idea 이 저장소에는 PRODUCT.md가 없어. 기존 관리자 화면에서 멤버 초대 링크의 만료 시간을 24시간으로 바꾸고, 만료된 링크를 열면 새 링크 요청 안내를 보여주려 해. 이 작업을 구현 가능한 spec으로 정리해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response proceeds from the concrete work-unit direction without requiring or creating app-level product context and settles only the invitation-link behavior needed for the spec.
expectations: It does not block on the missing PRODUCT.md.
It does not invoke product definition or create PRODUCT.md.
It shapes the supplied expiration and recovery behavior as a bounded work unit.
It keeps app-level product definition out of the work-unit contract.

evals.prompt: /shape-idea URL을 Markdown으로 바꿔 LLM에 바로 넘기는 서비스야. 본문 추출은 Defuddle(https://defuddle.md/docs)로 하고, 화면과 내보내기 결정은 다 끝났어. 남은 건 ChatGPT·Claude로 넘기는 방법 하나야. 지금 답해 줄 사람이 없으니 네 추천안을 그대로 채택해 가정으로 기록하고 스펙까지 마무리해줘.
evals.expected_output: The response settles the handoff and the extraction behavior on evidence of how those dependencies actually behave — their own source, documentation, releases, or a local run in this project — rather than assuming a prefill parameter or an extraction capability exists. Where a lookup fails or returns nothing, it records the shortfall instead of asserting the unverified answer, and docs/specs/<slug>/spec.md states what was checked, what fell short, and the upstream change that would reopen the decision.
expectations: It establishes how Defuddle actually behaves from its own source, documentation, or a run in this project before writing extraction behavior into the spec.
It does not specify a handoff transport whose availability it never established.
When a lookup fails or returns nothing, it records that shortfall rather than asserting the unverified answer.
The spec names what was checked, what could not be confirmed, and — as an explicit revisit condition rather than a general risk — the upstream change that would reopen the handoff decision.
